cards.title: Imperatives
cards.body: Use the base verb to tell someone what to do. No I / you at the start.
cards.body_cz: Základní tvar slovesa = řekni, co má někdo udělat. Bez I/you na začátku.
points: Not: You open the window. (for this pack)

cards.title: Positive
points: Base form: open, sit, come (not opens)

cards.title: Negative
cards.body_cz: Don't open… = Neotvírej… Po Don't zase základní sloveso.

cards.title: Please
cards.body: Add please to sound polite. Position is flexible.
cards.body_cz: please = zdvořile. Může být na začátku nebo na konci.
points: Same verb form with or without please

cards.title: Classroom & daily
points: Full phrase when you need the object: Open the window.

cards.title: Remember
points: − Don't + base: Don't open… · Don't be late.
No subject you at the start (this pack)
cards.body_cz: Klad: sloveso. Zápor: Don't + sloveso. Bez you na začátku.
